meta.title: Viavo: AI voice assistant for CarPlay, in 28 languages
meta.description: Press one button and say it your way. Viavo opens routes with a stop, calls, messages, plays music and radio, and answers out loud. 28 languages, a native voice in each.

faqItems: How is Viavo different from ChatGPT or Gemini in CarPlay?

ChatGPT and Gemini in CarPlay are built for conversation. Viavo also acts on what you say: it calls a contact, prepares an SMS message, plays music or a radio station, and from one sentence opens a route with a stop, or a place along the way, in your navigator.
Which languages does Viavo speak?

28: Arabic, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Croatian, Czech, Dutch, English, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Serbian, Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian and Vietnamese. In each one, the app’s screens and a native voice, a woman’s or a man’s.
Does it replace Siri?
No. Viavo is its own app on your CarPlay screen: open it and press one button.
Is it safe to use while driving?
Viavo is made for eyes on the road: one big button, answers out loud, and nothing on the car screen asks you to look at your phone.
Do I need to learn commands?
No. Press one button and say it the way you’d say it to a person.
Does it work without CarPlay?
Yes, on iPhone: the same one button, and you can also type.
Which apps does it work with?

Apple Maps, Google Maps and Waze; Apple Music, Spotify, YouTube Music, Amazon Music, Deezer and Apple Podcasts; Simple Radio, TuneIn and iHeartRadio; WhatsApp, SMS, Telegram and Slack; HomeKit, Calendar and Reminders. It also opens other apps by name.
How much does it cost?

Try Viavo for free: a new account starts with free credits or a free week of Viavo Plus, on the monthly or the yearly plan (one free week per person). If you cancel during the free week, access ends right away. Prices are in the App Store, in your currency.
How does WhatsApp work with Viavo?

Coming in Viavo 1.0.11 on iOS 27 or later. The current App Store version, 1.0.9, does not include this setup. Ask Viavo to read WhatsApp notifications received after setup. Only available notification previews are read, not past chats or attachments; previews can be incomplete. Sending needs separate opt-in and confirmation of the recipient and text.
What happens to my data?
It’s all in two documents.

whatsapp.title: How does WhatsApp work with Viavo?
whatsapp.availability: Coming in Viavo 1.0.11 on iOS 27 or later. The current App Store version, 1.0.9, does not include this setup.
whatsapp.receive: Ask Viavo to read WhatsApp notifications received after setup. Only available notification previews are read, not past chats or attachments; previews can be incomplete.
whatsapp.send: Sending needs separate opt-in and confirmation of the recipient and text. Private messages only, to unambiguously identified people whose notifications Viavo has received on this installation. A phone contact alone is not enough. Delivery is not guaranteed; phone drafts remain a fallback.
whatsapp.setup: While parked, open WhatsApp in Viavo Settings or onboarding and tap Connect. Add the receiving shortcut, enable its automation, then run it once and allow the requested access. Set up sending separately if you want it. Follow the same activation steps for that shortcut. Setup groups the shortcuts in the Viavo folder automatically.
